messages:
Rae (Ops): Quick follow-up on today's incident — we need: final status-page copy, a short customer-facing packet, and explicit ownership + due dates for all RCA action items. Also want a policy for when we share internal RCAs with customers.
Owen (SRE): I'll take the internal RCA and convert each remediation into JIRA tickets with owners. Draft RCA in 36h, final in 96h. I'll add a "recurring:autoscale" label to any related tickets for trend tracking.
Maya (Support): Support wants a 2-line FAQ and canned replies within 12h. We also need an escalation snippet for enterprise customers that details how to request the private packet.
Jon (Legal): Public status should be factual: impact window, restoration, and data exposure statement only. Private RCA sharing allowed only under existing NDA/contract or a signed one-off agreement. We should add a redaction policy for any internal-only details.
Priya (Product): Suggest status blurb: "Degraded text-generation performance from 05:11-05:39 UTC. Service restored. No customer data exposed. We are investigating and will post a detailed update within 72 hours." Short and clear.
Rae (Ops): Agree. Also propose we publish an anonymized appendix with metrics (no internal IPs/configs) if customers ask — that's public-friendly. Private RCA can contain full timeline and logs but redacted IPs/keys.
Alex (CS): For enterprise customers, offer an opt-in 'partner packet' delivered via secure portal. That keeps things auditable and avoids emailing RCAs. Who owns building that portal?
Owen (SRE): Portal is product infra work; Priya can evaluate. For now, Support should handle requests and log them. I'll include a short checklist in the RCA for what to redact before any external sharing.
Maya (Support): I'll draft canned replies and the escalation flow (including the NDA/portal note). ETA 12h. Please confirm the one-paragraph external summary so I can plug it in.
Jon (Legal): Redaction policy: remove stack traces with hostnames, obfuscated internal customer IDs, and any internal runbook tokens. We can share timelines, root cause summary at a high level, and remediation plans under NDA.
Rae (Ops): Action assignments:
- PRIYA: finalize one-paragraph external summary + approve status copy (due 3h).
- MAYA: canned replies + escalation flow (due 12h).
- OWEN: internal RCA draft + ticketize actions (draft 36h, final 96h); include recurrence appendix (24h).
- JON: legal redaction policy sign-off (due 24h).
- ALEX: coordinate partner-portal proposal vs interim email process (due 72h).
IncidentBot: Incident #2026-512 transitioned to RESOLVED by oncall.
Owen (SRE): I'll attach metric charts (p50/p95, error rate spikes, request volume) and link past incidents. If we see >3 similar events in the last 6 months, recommend a dedicated resilience epic.
Priya (Product): I'll also add a product impact note for prioritization. If recurrence is confirmed, we should scope a cross-team sprint.
Maya (Support): Noted. I'll tag any customer requests in Zendesk as "RCRequest" so Legal can track share requests.
Rae (Ops): Final status copy (Priya to post once Jon OKs legal wording):
"Service disruption: Text-generation experienced degraded performance from 05:11 to 05:39 UTC. Service restored. No customer data was exposed. We are investigating and will publish a detailed update within 72 hours."
Jon (Legal): That wording is fine. Remember: don't use "root cause" in public blurb 1; use "investigating" or "under review."
Rae (Ops): Thanks all. We'll run a 30-min follow-up sync in 24h to review the RCA draft and action ticket owners. Please keep all updates here so Support and Legal have the single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
